---
title: Environment Physics
---

Launch projectiles that collide with a depth-derived environment mesh. The
application supplies Rapier and enables depth before engine initialization.
Select to launch, then inspect collisions with the available geometry.

Desktop collision uses synthetic depth. On a device, missing or noisy room
coverage can change the result. Test performance and provide a way to recover
objects that get trapped by incomplete geometry.
